data.name: Terrifying Howl
data.description: You unleash a terrifying howl as a standard action. All enemies that have been shaken by you (usually through the Intimidate skill) within 30 feet must succeed at a Will save (DC %1) or be panicked for 1d4+1 rounds. Once an enemy has attempted a save versus this ability (whether successful or not), it's immune to this power for 24 hours.
